title: Fencing the commons: every enclosure Act in England and Wales, mapped
excerpt: I mapped every enclosure Act in Parliament's chronological tables, 4,104 of them, place by place. They came in two waves, and 48% were passed in the years of war with France, when wheat was dear.
seo_description: A map of 4,104 enclosure Acts in England and Wales: two waves, the Midland belt, and the war-years boom that peaked at 125 Acts in 1811.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Fencing the commons' in green and black on pale paper, beside a map of England and Wales covered in small dots coloured by decade, gold in the Midlands and blue in Norfolk and the south, and below it a bar chart of enclosure Acts per year with two peaks, in the 1770s and around 1811. Text: every enclosure Act in the Chronological Tables, 3,655 private Acts and 449 local Acts.
